start.title: Beyond the Wilderness
start.text:
You lead the flock past familiar hills.
A strange light flickers ahead.

choices.feedback: Exodus 3:3 — Moses turned aside to look at the great sight of the burning bush.

ignore_consequence.title: It Will Not Leave You
ignore_consequence.text:
The light flickers brighter still.
You cannot pretend you did not see.

stone_consequence.title: Not Like That
stone_consequence.text:
Mockery suits a child, not a man.
Go and see with humility.

approach_mountain.title: Toward the Mountain
approach_mountain.text:
Horeb rises before you in silence.
The glow is on its slope.

choices.feedback: Exodus 3:1 — Moses led the flock to Horeb, the mountain of God.
This sight is meant for you.

run_back_consequence.title: You Cannot Outrun It
run_back_consequence.text:
The glow burns in your memory.
Return and see the truth.

choices.feedback: You turn back to the slope.

call_jethro_consequence.title: This Is for You
call_jethro_consequence.text:
No one else is meant to stand here.
Go, and look.

see_bush.title: It Burns and Is Not Consumed
see_bush.text:
Flame wraps the bush. Yet it stands whole.
Nothing turns to ash.

choices.feedback: Exodus 3:3 — Moses said, "I will now turn aside and see this great sight, why the bush does not burn."
This fire is not yours to stop.
Do not turn from holy ground.

smother_consequence.title: Do Not Touch
smother_consequence.text:
This fire is not of your world.
Approach with awe, not hands.

hide_consequence.title: Do Not Hide
hide_consequence.text:
What hides from you is also revealed.
Step into the light.

choices.feedback: You step out from the rock.

voice_calls.title: "Moses! Moses!"
voice_calls.text:
A voice from the flame calls your name.
It knows you fully.

choices.feedback: Exodus 3:4 — God called to Moses from the midst of the bush, "Moses, Moses!" And Moses said, "Here I am."

demand_consequence.title: Bow First
demand_consequence.text:
You stand before holiness, not a man.
Answer with humility.

silent_consequence.title: Answer Him
silent_consequence.text:
He called your name aloud.
Do not leave Him with silence.

remove_sandals.title: Holy Ground
remove_sandals.text:
"Take off your sandals, Moses.
The place where you stand is holy."

choices.feedback: Exodus 3:5 — God commanded Moses to take off his sandals because the place where he stood was holy ground.

refuse_sandals_consequence.title: Obey First
refuse_sandals_consequence.text:
Comfort matters less than holiness.
Do as He asks.

argue_sandals_consequence.title: He Decides
argue_sandals_consequence.text:
He is the one who calls it holy.
Kneel and obey.

hide_face.title: I Am the God of Your Fathers
hide_face.text:
"I am the God of Abraham, Isaac,
and Jacob." You hide your face.

choices.feedback: Exodus 3:6 — Moses hid his face, for he was afraid to look upon God.
No man may see and live.

look_up_consequence.title: Lower Your Eyes
look_up_consequence.text:
His glory is more than you can bear.
Listen, do not stare.

see_affliction.title: I Have Seen Their Misery
see_affliction.text:
"I have heard My people cry in Egypt.
I will deliver them by your hand."

choices.feedback: Exodus 3:11 — Moses said to God, "Who am I that I should go to Pharaoh, and that I should bring the children of Israel out of Egypt?"
Do not flee what He calls.

boast_consequence.title: Not by Your Might
boast_consequence.text:
It is not your strength that frees them.
Speak honestly.

refuse_consequence.title: Do Not Flee
refuse_consequence.text:
You ran from Egypt once before.
This time, listen first.

i_will_be_with_you.title: I Will Be With You
i_will_be_with_you.text:
"I will be with you," He says.
"This shall be the sign."

choices.text: Ask His name to tell them
choices.feedback: Exodus 3:13 — Moses said to God, "Indeed, when I come to the children of Israel and say to them, 'The God of your fathers has sent me to you,' and they say to me, 'What is His name?' what shall I tell them?"

bargain_consequence.title: His Word Is Enough
bargain_consequence.text:
He has spoken. Trust the voice.
Ask only what is needed.

choices.text: Ask His name to tell them

i_am.title: I AM WHO I AM
i_am.text:
"Tell them I AM has sent you."
The name fills the silence.

choices.feedback: Exodus 3:14 — God tells Moses His name is "I AM WHO I AM."

question_consequence.title: Some Names Are Received
question_consequence.text:
You will not grasp it with the mind.
Receive it with the heart.

accept_mission.title: Go, Moses
accept_mission.text:
"Go. Speak to Pharaoh.
Lead My people out of Egypt."

choices.feedback: Exodus 3:10 — God commands Moses to go to Pharaoh and bring the Israelites out of Egypt.
He will give you the words.

plead_consequence.title: He Will Give the Words
plead_consequence.text:
Your tongue is not your strength.
His word will be on your lips.

another_consequence.title: He Has Chosen You
another_consequence.text:
It is your name He called by the bush.
You cannot pass it on.

stand_resolved.title: You Rise
stand_resolved.text:
The flame still burns. The bush still stands.
Your heart is no longer the same.

choices.feedback: Exodus 4:18-20 — Moses left Midian with his family to return to Egypt, carrying the staff of God.
You are no longer a shepherd of sheep.

return_sheep_consequence.title: Not Sheep — A People
return_sheep_consequence.text:
Your flock now is the children of Israel.
Turn toward Egypt.

ending.title: Toward Egypt
ending.text:
The desert opens before you.
God walks unseen at your side.
